title: LSP server rootfs resolution contract

environment.system_features: ACL GMP GNUTLS LIBSELINUX LIBXML2 MODULES NATIVE_COMP NOTIFY INOTIFY PDUMPER SECCOMP SQLITE3 THREADS TREE_SITTER ZLIB

mechanism: A real Emacs+LSP benchmark depends on both the Emacs client and the language-server process resolving from the same accounted rootfs closure.
hypothesis: The probe should inventory likely Python, C/C++, and Rust language-server commands and classify missing or host-resolved servers as a development gap unless a production rootfs is selected.
minimal_fixture: Executable lookup for common LSP server commands in the current Insula PATH.
predicted_behavior: Production mode requires Python LSP, C/C++ LSP, and Rust LSP server commands in the selected rootfs closure.
observed_behavior: prod=t inventory=((("tool" . "pyright-langserver") ("path" . "/usr/local/bin/pyright-langserver") ("found" . t)) (("tool" . "pyright") ("path" . "/usr/local/bin/pyright") ("found" . t)) (("tool" . "basedpyright-langserver") ("path" . "") ("found" . :json-false)) (("tool" . "pylsp") ("path" . "/usr/bin/pylsp") ("found" . t)) (("tool" . "clangd") ("path" . "/usr/bin/clangd") ("found" . t)) (("tool" . "rust-analyzer") ("path" . "/opt/soma/cargo/bin/rust-analyzer") ("found" . t))) python-lsp=t clangd="/usr/bin/clangd" rust-analyzer="/opt/soma/cargo/bin/rust-analyzer"

independent_checks.name: production Python LSP server requirement is classified
production C/C++ and Rust LSP requirements are classified

counterexample: A direct text edit can pass a filesystem checker while the intended LSP server never started or came from the host.
derived_gym_requirement: LSP tasks must prove server process identity, workspace root, synchronized document version, and rootfs-owned server/toolchain resolution.
